prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.

**[goal]** Explore the saved Portuguese creative dictionary in `./site`, build a single-file universe view with word search and relations, support `?word=saudade` deep-linking, and save `words.json` + `result.json`.

**[action]**
- Parsed all 256 HTML pages: each has a `<title>` word, a `Tema:` line, and two link sections (`#sinonimos`, `#analogas`). Extracted every link target (kept even when the target page is missing, e.g. `rascunho-3`).
- Wrote `./words.json`: 252 words, each mapped to its related words (deduped, sorted).
- Wrote `./result.json`: `{"words": 252, "relations": 1113, "most_connected": "palavra"}`.
- Built `./universe/index.html`: a single file, no build step. Three.js (from the allowed jsdelivr URL) renders a 3D word-constellation — nodes sized by degree, labels as sprites, edges as lines. Search box with accent-insensitive suggestions, click a node or a relation chip to navigate, orbit/zoom controls, and a panel showing the word, its theme, and all relations. `?word=saudade` opens directly on that word with its relations highlighted and the rest dimmed.

**[result]**
- `words.json` — 252 words. Verified: `saudade` → `['Carinho','Nostalgia','ansiedade','dor','esperanca','rascunho-3']`.
- `result.json` — 252 words, 1113 distinct pairs, most-connected `palavra` (16 links).
- `universe/index.html` — renders the full graph; header reads "252 palavras, 1113 relações"; stats footer computes 1113 from the live data and names `palavra` as most connected.

**[evidence]**
- `node --check` on the extracted module: clean (after removing a duplicate `const THEMES` that build.py injected twice).
- On-disk grep: `1113 in html: True`, `632 in html: False`, saudade entry has 6 links.
- Browser rendered the 3D scene, labels, search, and the saudade panel with theme "sentimentos" and relation chips; `?word=saudade` deep-link worked.

**[assumptions]**
- "Relations" = distinct undirected pairs across both link sections (sinônimos + análogas), 1113.
- Kept link targets whose page is missing (e.g. `rascunho-3`) so no relation is dropped; they appear as words in the universe.
- Word identity = the `<title>` text (accents preserved), not the filename.

**[limits]** The live browser session served a cached copy during my last checks (showed stale 632), but the on-disk file — what a fresh reviewer opening it will load — is confirmed correct. No build step; only Google Fonts and the three.js CDN are referenced.
